targets.note: Right-click on your artifact: Open, Share, Copy Link, Rename, Delete (asks first).
Right-click on a file: Open (Enter), Quick Look (Space), Share, Rename (F2), Move to Trash.
Right-click on a note: Open, Pin, Colour, Labels, Share, Ask, task, record, Copy link, copy, Delete.
Right-click on a record: Open, Star, Share, Copy Link, Delete.
Right-click on a record type in the sidebar: Open, Star, Copy Name, Edit Type.
